question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_q4_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_q4_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_sales
    WHERE sales_q4_2019 > 0
        AND sales_q4_2020 >= sales_q4_2019 * 1.20
),
product_city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        c.cust_city,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as sales_amount
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_q4_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_q4_2020,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id
),
total_sales_all AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_sales) as grand_total FROM product_totals
),
product_with_share AS (
    SELECT 
        pt.prod_id,
        pt.sales_q4_2019,
        pt.sales_q4_2020,
        pt.total_sales,
        pt.sales_q4_2019 * 100.0 / ts.grand_total as share_q4_2019,
        pt.sales_q4_2020 * 100.0 / ts.grand_total as share_q4_2020,
        pt.sales_q4_2020 * 100.0 / ts.grand_total - pt.sales_q4_2019 * 100.0 / ts.grand_total as pct_point_change,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pt.total_sales DESC) as rank_num,
        COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count
    FROM product_totals pt
    CROSS JOIN total_sales_all ts
)
SELECT 
    p.prod_id,
    p.prod_name,
    pws.total_sales,
    pws.share_q4_2019,
    pws.share_q4_2020,
    pws.pct_point_change,
    pws.rank_num,
    pws.total_count,
    (pws.rank_num::FLOAT / pws.total_count) as pct_rank
FROM product_with_share pws
INNER JOIN products p ON pws.prod_id = p.prod_id
WHERE pws.rank_num <= CAST(CEIL(pws.total_count * 0.20) AS INTEGER)
ORDER BY ABS(pws.pct_point_change) ASC
